packageName: A failed capture with no usage gives its hold back
ownerApproval: 2026-09-17, explicit: release to zero only where no usage row exists; keep the reservation and audit row; do not change admission, the STT cap, the initial reservation or the existing successful settlement; a failed operation that does have usage must never be FAILED_NO_USAGE
important: Reserved units are not money. Nothing here recovers spend, because none was made: the eight failed speech attempts produced no transcript and no usage row. What was recovered is permission to keep working.

firstAttemptRefusedItself.what: The first run of this migration aborted on its own postcondition: MEASURED is 23, expected 21.
firstAttemptRefusedItself.why: The expected counts were read minutes earlier and the owner kept using the app in between, so two more real calls landed.
firstAttemptRefusedItself.outcome: Nothing was written. The postconditions were rewritten to assert relationships against a snapshot taken inside the same transaction rather than numbers typed from an earlier reading.

change: the settlement CHECK gains FAILED_NO_USAGE alongside MEASURED and CONSERVATIVE_ESTIMATE_UNMEASURED; zero was already inside the allowed range
new public.rpc_ai_test_release_unused_reservation_service(uuid), service_role only, PUBLIC execute revoked
it refuses when a usage row exists (AI_RELEASE_REFUSED_USAGE_EXISTS) and when already settled (AI_RELEASE_ALREADY_SETTLED)
it takes the same singleton budget lock the reservation writer and the measured settlement take
a one-time release of holds with no usage, restricted to rows older than five minutes so nothing in flight could be caught
notChanged: STT cap 200000 on all 8 STT rows
rpc_ai_test_budget_reserve_service md5 6cd527442c55a96a81bf885084755451, identical before and after
the measured settlement path from PKG-019B
every reservation and audit row: 50 before, 50 after

tests.method: Run against the live functions on canonical DEV inside a transaction deliberately aborted at the end, so nothing persisted. Three reservations were created, driven through each path, and the whole thing rolled back.
tests.rollbackProof: After the proof, reservation rows are still 50 and usage rows still 23, so the three test reservations and the test usage row left no trace.

stillOpen: Nothing calls the release RPC yet. The backfill cleared the existing holds, but a future failed capture will still leak its hold until the speech function calls this on failure. That is a change to the speech function and was not made, because the owner limited this step to the budget engine.
